description_en: Modifies a scaling plan for an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-elastic-plan --elastic-plan-name test --start-time 2022-01-01T12:01:00Z --end-time 2025-01-01T12:01:00Z --cron-expression 0_20_14_0_0_0 --target-size 32ACU --db-cluster-id amv-wz9509beptiz0000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyElasticPlan

parameters.description_en:
The name of the scaling plan.

>  You can call the [DescribeElasticPlans](~~601334~~) operation to query the names of scaling plans.
parameters.description_zh:
弹性计划名称。
> 调用[DescribeElasticPlans](~~601334~~)接口可以查看指定集群的弹性计划名称。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.name: elastic_plan_name

parameters.description_en:
The start time of the scaling plan.

>  Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
parameters.help_en:
The start time of the scaling plan.

parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en:
The end time of the scaling plan.

>  Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
parameters.help_en:
The end time of the scaling plan.

>  Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description_en: A CORN expression that specifies the scaling cycle and time for the scaling plan.
parameters.description_zh: Cron表达式，表示弹性计划的变配周期和变配时间。
parameters.help_en: A CORN expression that specifies the scaling cycle and time for the scaling plan
parameters.help_zh: Cron表达式，表示弹性计划的变配周期和变配时间
parameters.name: cron_expression

parameters.description_en:
The desired specifications of elastic resources after scaling.

> 

*   If the scaling plan uses **EIUs** and **Default Proportional Scaling for EIUs** is enabled, you do not need to specify this parameter. In other cases, you must specify this parameter.

*   You can call the [DescribeElasticPlanSpecifications](~~601278~~) operation to query the specifications that are supported for scaling plans.
parameters.description_zh:
目标规格。
> - 只有弹性资源类型为**存储加速服务弹性计划**并且启用了**存储加速服务(EIU)按比例默认弹性**，可以不填写该参数。其它情况下，该参数为必填项。
- 调用[DescribeElasticPlanSpecifications](~~601278~~)接口可以查看弹性计划支持的弹性变配规格。
